name: Amakase Miharu
source: The real Miharu, a daughter of Professor Amakase. She's terribly fond of Nemu and bananas. After experiencing a serious injury, Miharu returns to her normal life, getting the baton from her android twin. Needless to say, she's also not indifferent to Jun'ichi.
